title: Rolling a seven at the Dice House
description: The player bets again and throws the dice, which come up 5 and 2. On the seven, the prize in its case of ice blocks, a pair of spike shoes, pops out of it in a puff of smoke, free, and a bomb box takes its place in the case. He picks the shoes up and they go on.
